answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices via zero-knowledge verifiable delay to bound adversarial transitions. Mandating staking collateral exposed to slashing penalties, the system turns the fragile jetty of identity replication into a crystal capital barrier, proving that the expected attack utility of Sybil multiplication remains strictly negative. This cryptoeconomic asymmetry forces rational agents toward a strict Nash equilibrium as the insurmountable glacier of opportunity costs permanently dominates deviationist payoffs.
